# BJ Medical Billing Service

> BJ Medical Billing Service supports healthcare practices with eligibility and benefits verification, medical coding, charge entry, claim submission, payment posting, denial management, insurance A/R follow-up, provider credentialing, and full revenue cycle management.

## Services

- [Medical Coding](https://bjmbilling.com/services/medical-coding): Documentation-led CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, and modifier review before claim submission.
- [Claim Submission](https://bjmbilling.com/services/claim-submission): Charge entry, claim scrubbing, EDI submission, acknowledgement review, and rejection correction.
- [Denial Management](https://bjmbilling.com/services/denial-management): Denial categorization, corrected claims, reconsiderations, appeals, deadline tracking, and root-cause reporting.
- [Eligibility & Benefits](https://bjmbilling.com/services/eligibility-benefits): Active coverage, subscriber data, patient responsibility, referral, and authorization indicator verification.
- [AR Follow-Up](https://bjmbilling.com/services/ar-followup): Insurance follow-up organized by aging, payer, claim status, filing risk, and documented next action.
- [Credentialing & Full RCM](https://bjmbilling.com/services/credentialing-rcm): Provider file preparation, CAQH and payer enrollment tracking, plus full revenue cycle coordination.

## Focus Areas

CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, EDI claims, clearinghouse workflows, eligibility, prior auth, denial codes, appeals, A/R aging, CAQH, credentialing, HIPAA-aware operations
